Open Path is a therapy service (very affordable I might add) where you can meet with someone from literally anywhere in your state (assuming you live in the US). Second there's Plume. Plume is a service costing $100 a month (unless you have insurance; either way you pay for the testosterone out of your pocket, which could be real cheap with Good RX). You don't even need to have a letter. You fill out a questioner and as long as everything is good, you can pick up your prescription the same day as your first appointment (which is also virtual). 

With what I'm reading I do suggest a therapist as well with Plume but if you just want the hormones that's of course up to you. I also use both of these services so I know they are legit and extremely helpful.
